title: Verify show --json note ordering presentation against the dense-feed rule
outcome: Verify show --json note ordering presentation against the dense-feed rule
acceptance: The default show evidence page (CLI show, its --json form and MCP show) emits its retained rows in root-work feed position order, resolved with work_root_object_position. It gets there by sorting an output copy after selection, latest-note normalisation and byte eviction, so which rows are kept or evicted, and verification-to-environment closure, are unchanged. Asserted timestamps stay metadata. One test asserts the complete emitted sequence, with late and non-holder notes included, with asserted timestamps that disagree with append order, and with a peer's non-holder notes interleaved between the holder's notes. docs/features/cli-and-mcp.md states this for the default page, as distinct from the --notes window.

completion.summary: The default show evidence page (CLI show, --json and MCP show) now emits its kept rows in root-work feed order. Each row carries a never-serialised root_position filled with work_root_object_position, and show sorts only its output copy after selection, latest-note normalisation and byte eviction, so kept rows and verification-to-environment closure are unchanged. A test asserts the full emitted sequence with interleaved holder and peer notes, clocks against append order, and late notes by both sessions; cli-and-mcp.md and local-work-system.md state the rule. Landed as 316ef05 (full gate test-1029cf51 passed, rounds 1-3 reviewed, round 3 clean from Codex and Claude, readiness ready on all three live stores), pushed to master; not installed, because the install freeze holds until the TermAl live import is verified. Independent Codex evaluation 0784598a passed criterion 1. Selection by newest position stays with the independent root w-fa8c00d51512.
